about: What otter-names-times-one-space.txt reads into. The file is written for these tests in the layout of the export Otter makes of a voice note (SOURCES.md): each header is the speaker's name, one space and the time, with nothing after it; the paragraph on the line after it; a blank line between turns; and the closing line with no line feed after it. The second turn's words end in a time, as a header does, and are words since they stand on the line straight after a header.

turns.text: Good morning. Shall we start with the budget?
Then book it for forty people.
